```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

# Define the start and end dates
start_date <- ymd("2000-01-01")
end_date <- ymd("2024-06-25")

# Create a sequence of dates from start_date to end_date
date_range <- seq(from = start_date, to = end_date, by = "day")

# Convert the date_range to a list of strings
date_range <- as.character(date_range)

# Initialize an empty list to store the results
days <- list()

# Loop over each date in the date range
for (date in date_range) {
  tryCatch({
    cat("Processing date:", date, "\n")
    # Fetch data for the given date
    result <- mlb_game_pks(date = date, level_ids = 1)
    
    # Debugging: Print the structure of the result
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      print(str(result))
    } else {
      cat("No result for date:", date, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Check if the result contains the expected structure
    if ("dates" %in% names(result) && length(result$dates) > 0) {
      games <- result$dates[[1]]$games
      if (!is.null(games) && length(games) > 0) {
        # Convert the list to a data frame
        games_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(games, as.data.frame))
        # Add the date column to the data frame
        games_df$date <- date
        # Store the data frame in the list
        days[[date]] <- games_df
      } else {
        cat("No games found for date:", date, "\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("No dates found in result for date:", date, "\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error processing date:", date, ":", e$message))
  })
}

# Combine all data frames in the list into one data frame
if (length(days) > 0) {
  final_df <- bind_rows(days, .id = "date")
  # View the resulting combined data frame
  print(final_df)
} else {
  print("No data was retrieved from the API.")
}

```
